# Etsy

> > Etsy is a global online marketplace connecting millions of buyers with creative entrepreneurs selling handmade, vintage, and unique goods.

Etsy enables independent sellers to showcase and sell handcrafted items, vintage treasures, and craft supplies. The platform serves as a discovery engine for unique products across diverse categories, from jewelry and home décor to art and clothing.

## Key Topics

- handmade goods
- vintage items
- marketplace
- independent sellers
- product categories
- creative entrepreneurs
- unique gifts
- craft supplies
- artisan products
- shop navigation
- browse experience
- e-commerce platform

## Marketplace Navigation

- [Shop All Categories](https://www.etsy.com/categories): Main marketplace directory for browsing all product categories on Etsy
